description: Creates a 30-minute sandbox session of a Cnamio test application, without an account or credentials. Returns application_id, auth_token, expires_at and user_id. A sandbox session answers from a simulated DNS provider: nothing real is read or written and any domain name connects at once; domains whose first label is conflict (for example conflict.example.com) simulate records already in the way; a first label of pending (pending.example.com) simulates a record that never propagates; the provider token invalid is refused.
name: start_sandbox
title: Get a sandbox session
